name: game
description: Make a game, from idea to release. A design studio: ideation, fun targeting, core loop, systems and economy, progression, levels and UX, art direction, a game brief, a prototype plan, design diagrams and a one-page design as HTML, SVG and PDF. A review board backed by cited rules from 38 game-development books: game-studio-cpo and auditors for systems, balance, code, performance and QA. A Godot build kit: scripted bots and balance models, upgrade trees, feature seams and save migrations, headless runs and tests, frame-cost measurement, rendered-frame checks, pixel art, audio, release builds and store pages, and habits for a worker fleet.
